notes.title: Next patch information
notes.content:
Greetings!
[p align="start"]I’ve come to you with news and some pictures. We’re currently working on the next patch, which seems like it’s going to be even bigger than the last major one.
[p align="start"]I’ll briefly go over it now, but first, let me clarify that the next patch won’t be coming soon (for various reasons) - most likely, whoa, around the end of October. Yes, it’s a while away, but we also want to pack a lot into this patch, and that requires careful planning and artwork.
[p align="start"]For example, we’ve already finished "Roadside Business" - a feature that allows you to set up food stalls on the roads and earn money from them. For instance, you can open a few shawarma stands. Or potato stalls. In total, we’ve come up with 11 different options, with possible duplicates.
[p align="start"]Here’s a picture:
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/0d09323dab36629b7d3b5a8646cbccc083ce3b7a.jpg"]
[p align="start"]We also have a large amount of content work (requiring artwork and writing) related to problems in different locations. For example, someone attacks, something explodes, and you have to resolve the issue. The content is text-based, accompanied by images and action choices. We’ve called this "Location Troubles".
[p align="start"]Here are some pictures:
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/616dda975cc470c51d19b019e8dddced7a2a941e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/aecc3169e1b013cb3a16d634a4f8aee76ad387b1.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/6f6b362affc43c84b0823b079b0a3982135502a6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/9b50cc43219d4e4f0c8d909159c168f823d9fa4c.png"]
[p align="start"]Of course, we’ve already made some changes to the map interface to position the buttons more conveniently.
[p align="start"]Right now, we’re planning to tackle new content with the working title "The Usual Suspects". Things would move faster, but this content includes gear for mercenaries to equip. At least, that’s what we’d like to do.

Also, in our near-term plans, we have content tentatively titled "Memories", which will allow you to replay battles against all the bosses you've previously defeated in the game.
[p align="start"]So, that’s the news. We’ll share more pictures in the future, especially ones related to the "Location Troubles" content, so you know we haven’t abandoned the game (lol).
[p align="start"]Naturally, we’re still active on Discord and the Steam community, implementing changes into the game (including some suggested by players - though not all, of course, since we’re the ones developing the game) that we believe are right, and so on.

notes.title: The Big Beautiful Patch
notes.content:
Greetings! The patch is finally here, bringing new content, changes, and - of course -some bugs (where would we be without them?). We’ve named it the The Big Beautiful Patch because, well, it’s big (or bigger than other patches). Let’s get straight to the point - here are the patch notes in random order.

Our 1-year-in-Early-Access trailer (yes, again):
[previewyoutube="HbWEtbXcS5A;full"][/previewyoutube]


 1. Mercenary Events (Text-Based) – Every few days, one of your mercenaries will strike up a conversation with you in town. Click on them and talk to receive a reward. For example:

    - Peasants with chickens might give you Eggs.

    - Axe-wielding mercenaries might buy a new axe and give you their old one.

    - Beekeepers might share some Honey.

    - And so on.

 2. Fishing! New Fishing! Wait, actually, it was already in the last patch, but we planned to add it in this one. So I’ll leave this point here.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/c98f1880fdd6e787415dd838b4d76976e87b0f6e.png"]

 3. A Small but Nice Change – The Blacksmith in Normingham now sells Chains and shackles.

 4. Ten New Food Items, Plus One Special Addition – Cheese!

    - We’ve added new dishes that require ingredients from recent patches.

    - Additionally, we’ve finally balanced all other food (previously, there was no balance—everything was done by feel).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/ebc14c817a0b10b30e4dd719fe4c3c97ad15b375.png"]

 5. Rework of Several Cooking Branch Skills

    - Two new skills have replaced freed-up skill slots:

    - If a mercenary eats food of lower rarity than what they’ve already consumed, they’ll heal but won’t lose their current food buff.

    - The second talent enhances the healing effect from food.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/bb3d460204adb058d434e3176a51a09cacdd8717.png"]

 6. UI Improvement – When right-clicking a mercenary to feed them, only the food in your inventory is now displayed (instead of all food, as before).

 7. New Location – Udderville

    Along with this location, we’ve added:

    - A new trade good: Milk.

    - New mercenaries: Manotaur (playable) and Beetaur (non-playable).

    - New transports: Bullock and Great Bull (unlocked via reputation).

    - Three new quests.

    - A new mini-boss: Crack (it’s all about the milk).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/f2afd3bf8dbe2b6e67d0fe895635aa933f5b332b.png"]

 8. More New Quests in Other Locations

    - For example, in Sheepington, there’s a quest that can be started immediately but continued only at a certain point in the game.

    - Two new mercenaries have been added here, one of which is playable.

 9. Call It a Nerf, We Call It Balancing

    - Tradesman skills that previously recharged mercenaries’ attacks by 100% now recharge them by 50%.

10. Increased Rewards for Delivery Quests

    - Added progression - you now earn more reputation and money for each delivery level.

11. Reputation for Goods – Changes

    - You no longer gain reputation for selling goods that a town doesn’t need, even if the type matches.

    - BUT you now get TWICE the reputation if:

    - The town needs the good, OR

    - You’re pitching a good of the right type (even if the town doesn’t currently need it).

    - This is definitely a buff - EFFECTIVELY (not in a real number, I dare you!), reputation requirements in towns have been halved (from 10,000 to 5,000).

12. Second Demand Type Added to Many Towns

    - Some towns have had their demand types adjusted to better match the goods they buy/sell, making reputation easier to earn.

    - Yet another buff - wow!

13. New Skill in the Quality of Life Altar

    - Increases the size of traders’ wallets in towns.

14. Early-Game Quality of Life Altar

    - We realized the Quality of Life Altar was too deep in the game, so we’ve added a Children’s Quality of Life Altar in the Ruins location.

    - Same bonuses, but they can’t be maxed out.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/2f0386c34b156a934f4e7b4b6a4b518f541f784e.png"]

15. Reputation Reward in Sheepington

    - Tied to Quick Battles.

16. Quick Battles Nerfed (it's an upgrade):

    - Enemies on low-danger roads are now weaker - there are fewer of them.

17. Negotiations with Enemy Groups

    - You can now negotiate with any enemy group on the roads, even the last one (previously impossible).

    - The chance of triggering a dialogue to avoid battle has been increased.

    - Basically, tradesman now have a better chance to talk their way out.

    - Still can’t negotiate with ambushers, though.

18. Almost Forgot! New Talent Branch – Strategy :cat:

    - A whole new Strategy talent tree with 8 talents, each containing 4 sub-talents (32 talents total).

    - Pick the right ones to build a powerful squad.

    - With the Strategy tree, even common Plebs become dangerous!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/8bdb1fa90c26198c1b8d7aa31aac51abb30036b5.png"]

Small note: We have removed Turkish language support (it has not been updated for a long time and was abandoned by translators). This patch does not yet have Japanese language support for new texts - support will appear later.

Thanks for being with us!

notes.title: Bigtopiatch 0.2025.05.26
notes.content:
Changes Related to Localization (More relevant for translators or users of unofficial Thai translations) - We’ve added language selection support in the menu.
For Thai localization users: Delete the settings.ini file from the game’s settings folder one last time, then place an empty language_exists.txt file in the lang_tha folder. After that, you’ll be able to select the language in the settings. Of course, the actual translation files must also be present in the same folder. (Reminder: The game does not officially include Thai localization, but I’ve heard an unofficial version exists)
We’ve also added full support for all Latin characters, though this might cause some unexpected issues.
If you encounter text-related errors after the patch (usually involving the word "language"), try to delete the settings.ini file from the game folder first. This issue can occur with any language. If that doesn’t help, contact me.

Additionally, this patch also brings back full Korean language support.

Now, onto the patch!

1. Various bug fixes.

2. Map screen interface redesigned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/bb6ac33764fe362d43a07963fbe4fbbfe1982f62.jpg

3. 21 new trade goods.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/4524b4bcd980e375fffa4e44c2aaedb30d19ef7f.jpg

4. Reworked goods in cities. Players who are already in the game will receive these changes within 2-3 in-game days as cities refresh their goods. Now, every city has a starred item - bring and sell it, and upon the next refresh, you’ll be able to buy something new (e.g., Silver ore - yes, there’s a location like that).

5. Random goods in cities have been removed - now, if you travel to City A for a specific item, it will be there upon arrival (unless the city refreshes its goods, except for starred items, which disappear after a refresh). We’ve also made it so that if you buy a good somewhere, the most profitable place to sell it will be in a nearby location.

6. Each city’s "Demand" now includes a good that matches the city’s type - this helps with reputation gain. We’ve already added many ways to earn reputation, but in the future, I’d like reputation to be granted only for selling goods that a location actually needs (no more buying and immediately reselling). However, it’s too early to implement this change yet. For now, in this patch, selling goods to NPC merchants is no longer the main source of reputation gain.

7. Reworked buying/selling mechanics - selling goods is now more profitable initially, but the price drops if you repeatedly sell the same good to a specific merchant. The same applies to buying: if you keep buying a certain good from a merchant, its price will rise. Prices gradually return to their original values over time.

8. Merchants no longer have unlimited money. The more you sell to an NPC merchant, the more money they have - but not infinitely (currently capped at 2x their original wallet size). Their wallet size slowly returns to its default value over time.

9. Added a clarification for the second passive ability in the Catmancy - leveling it up will allow you to talk to certain cats (as before, just added the explanation text).

10. Nearly every city now has a strongpowergigachad cat offering delivery quests. Successful deliveries increase reputation in the location and grant money (currently a profitable +20% bonus over the base item value). These quests are endless, have difficulty ranks, and can be tracked in a dedicated tab in the quest menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/2f9e0c40412f9eede8e42a6ba835881e13e3bed2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/3d478c752a89f20d1772e93e07e29ed385222da5.jpg

11. New reward in Praydon: the monk Seniron Soyfist. Plus 3 new enemies and one secret opponent.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/1234a7302bc993fa1e37fea7297b486c3168179c.jpg

12. Road encounter - Fortune Teller. Pay money for a prediction: more money, goods, food, something negative… or nothing at all.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/1ead72c1da7bea5f2b38d1691cde1a496a646a33.jpg

13. The location Bigtopia isn’t fully finished yet, but you SHOULD visit it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/28becd72bcbc2790dd389915b9861eaa9e3e42db.jpg

14. We’ve completed the current major story segment - now you can gather everyone at the table by blowing a horn and continue the main storyline.

15. Various fixes - for example, repairing carts in quests now requires **Wheels** (a new trade good).

What’s Next:

1. We’re considering raising the minimum screen resolution to fit more UI elements by default. Unfortunately, I don’t have stats on how many players use 1280×720, but we’d prefer at least 1440×900.
2. We’re mostly done with locations, though we have one more planned soon - we want to add bulls (cows?) as a pleb hauler, and their location. Next, we’ll focus on road events and other content: quests for Bigtopia, Sheepington, and Warmington. We’re also brainstorming ideas for the game’s first dungeon, likely in Bigtopia, and what reward it should offer.
3. I’m not a fan of the strategy of assembling a party exclusively with legendary mercenaries. I’ll think of an interesting way to address this, but it’ll likely result in restricting full legendary-only parties. Some legendary mercs are so strong that balancing a full team of them seems impossible.

As a bonus, we've added a minor Supporter pack DLC. With hats, of course.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751590/TRADESMAN_Deal_to_Dealer__HATS_Supporter_Pack

notes.title: Patch 0.2025.04.04, gentlemen and gentleladies!
notes.content:
Greetings.
Anticipating questions and frustrations about why this patch is so small, I’ll start the patch notes with an excuse: both my (the programmer’s) primary and backup computers broke down at the same time.
But now everything is fine. We finished the patch in two days and are releasing it. First, let me tell you what’s in the patch, and then — what’s next. Yes, according to our plans, the patch was supposed to be released about 10 days ago, but here we are.

This patch has two main features:
1. The Praydon location with quests (but no reputation rewards for now).
The location offers three quests of different types.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/c304d19af570c87406418284b7218122c5cbd0dd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/4a974cc25dc58cba08cbae6ac9445433bd089e97.jpg

2. The Independent Trading Assistant — Rombus the Cat, created together with the game’s Discord community (not the entire community, but we brainstormed ideas in a voice channel).
Rombus the Cat will help you trade. To talk to him, you need to rescue 10 cats and upgrade the cat-related talent tree by two points. You can find Rombus in Watchmansham I.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/02c4a8203bc27b68cc095eb7f0eecb891410779c.jpg

Rombus can sell your goods for you. More info under the question mark button. Talk to Rombus first, then check your wagon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/e329b9c55bd6574e50a9ebd4853537fca4a69290.jpg

What’s Next (no specifics yet):
0. New enemies: Mercenaries you cannot hire.
1. Rework supply and demand in cities.
2. Shift focus toward trading: Plan to adjust prices for each trader based on how often you trade with them. Trading will require more strategy.
3. Add delivery quests in every settlement. Rewards include both money (as profitable as selling goods) and reputation (to grind faster).
4. The Shapitoshevo location with quests, including story quests, and the conclusion of the current story arc. After this, we’ll focus on global improvements before tackling the desert biome.
5. Mercenary traits (we call this Hobby): Similar to systems in other games, but simplified. Alongside this, we plan to add new road events and challenges that can be solved alone or using mercenary traits (hobbies).
6. Other ideas: Still in early stages (one or two sentences), so more work is needed.

Let us know if you spot any issues, and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Patch 0.2025.03.10
notes.content:
Hello! An important note in this patch: We’ve transitioned from the old version of Game Maker (the game development environment) to the latest version, and if there are any bugs in the new version, we can’t check them immediately. After playing for a while and testing the core mechanics, we haven’t found anything critical, but anything can happen, and if it does, everything will be fixed.

Now, the patch itself.

1. Wandering Merchants. Four wandering merchants can appear in a random location (out of seven) and sell goods that are not typical for that location. Each wandering merchant has their own set of goods.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/9011e5d3294c8b39449454a06aa8f562a775dd6b.jpg

2. Auction in Hoboken. More information about the auction can be found under the question mark when opening the menu, but the essence is clear — raise your bids, win the goods.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/615267c9ae3585bc5a625420d85eaa4f008f0e31.jpg

3. Glimmergloom location and Quests. Come and see everything for yourself.
(No screenshot :)

4. New Enemy — Yellow Ghost, and a new status effect — Bond.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/cda440713ad237a8caa905716c47c5b526128753.gif

5. You can now select a product and track where it is sold and bought.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/cb5ea619c8e0978fd817f4bdff12e3064da78836.jpg

6. Additional Information about Reputation Rewards — earned or not, in the squad or in reserve, in the inventory or in storage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/c78493c75d43c9ea8aff7b89529bfa75134e96e6.jpg

7. New Item — Chains and Shackles. Look for it in the game.

8. Wagons now have characteristics that help in various aspects of the game. These characteristics won’t turn the game upside down; they’re just a small, pleasant bonus.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/b1bf3938abd80e26fcdbdd10b104c10c0f297170.jpg

9. [strike]On laptops, the game now forces the dedicated GPU. Let’s see how this affects the number of complaints about the game lagging on laptops.[/strike]

notes.title: Patch 0.2025.02.16
notes.content:
IMPORTANT BUT NOT CRITICAL:
Temporary suspension of Turkish language support (the volunteers who offered to translate have been out of contact for a long time) and temporary suspension of Korean language support (long delays between translations).
Support for these fan-made (please take this into account) localizations has been temporarily suspended as of 2025.02.12 due to delays in updates. We have reached a point where changes are being made to the text files, and playing the game in languages that have not been translated in time will lead to inaccuracies and/or errors. We believe it is quite unpleasant to play a game that is only partially translated into your native language. The language tags on the Steam store page for these languages have been removed, and the corresponding languages in the game have been reset to English. Current translations will continue to work but may be inaccurate.
ATTENTION: Updates to these languages ​​are possible in the future, and ideally we would like to have all texts fully translated by release, but this is what we currently have.

Regarding this patch:
1. Veteran - added the passive ability Guard.
2. Woodserker, Eyevan Bobachad, Redserker Spearman, Redserker Warrior, Redserker Father, Feorge the Destructive - added the passive ability Zerker.
3. Acolyte, Inquisitor, Peacemaker, Piousville Crossbowman, Zael the Dismal - added the passive ability Holyman.
4. Peasant with a Chicken - new passive ability "Basket of Eggs".
5. The Tactics talent branch ability, which provided complete protection against critical hits, has been nerfed.
6. The new big boss added in the previous patch has been slightly nerfed. This nerf is related to the fact that the main strategy against this boss relied on the passive ability that was nerfed above.
7. Small bonuses have been added for ALL melee and ranged mercenaries.
8. Every 7 in-game days, starting from the 8th day, a random weekly effect is active (the list of effects, of course, includes the "Normal Week" effect).

What's Next:
We are almost done with the next small patch. In short: one important mini-game and roaming merchants.

5. New winter location - Warmington.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/b00845fb7d19863c0b5900064ce836f018dd8dea.gif
7. Several new locations, currently empty - base for future patches.

9. Four new mini-bosses and one new big boss.

11. Talent tree - Catomancy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/170c3b4de7f4199eb5417957941873bfe4ce4238.png
12. The event for obtaining the Soul Chalice has been reworked and turned into a quest (the essence remains the same, but it’s now clearer how to obtain it). The blacksmith in Fortsville no longer requires silver outside of the quest.
13. Two interactive totems with temporary weak free boosts in Furryfoot Village and Beastborough. Only one can be active at a time. Very weak, very free.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/5b7a8d572de3faa2db9fa1820fb40092571914a8.gif
14. Reputation rewards in almost all old settlements: boosts, boosts, boosts!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/2affaf3c8ecf822c142896baa95b7e3cdde1e55b.png
15. Six new goods and places where they are bought and sold.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/819363e478e2605827cf07b4d17d867bc394790b.png
16. New parameter for mercenaries - melee and ranged combat. Currently, there are few interactions with these parameters, but they exist. Base for the future.
17. Now you can see which goods will appear in the next update for merchants when demand is met (goods marked with colored star icon).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/a6c93efbd42e0d86635e87fc706c2656f19307ca.gif
18. When purchasing new hauler, the old one will be moved to the reserve if there is space (otherwise, it will be lost as before).
19. Function to partly merge boost values at the start of a battle - can be turned off in the settings.
20. New Year is coming soon, gamers! ːkotː

notes.title: Patch 0.2024.12.07
notes.content:
Greetings! We’ve made another patch. I want to clarify that the content of this patch required interference with already created saves, and something might go wrong, although everything went smoothly during testing. Well, the thing is, if something does go wrong, we won’t be able to fix it since we simply won’t find the necessary data. I hope that doesn’t happen, and if it does, you will understand, accept, and forgive us as usual.

ATTENTION: IF WE DID NOT SUCCEED, YOU WILL HAVE TO ERASE YOUR PROGRESS AND START THE NEW GAME. BUT WITHOUT THESE CHANGES WE WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN ABLE TO ADD WHAT WE ADDED.

So, what’s in this patch? Let’s go!

1. Mercenaries can now read two scrolls (it was previously one). Of course, there are limitations, which you can read about in the game under the question mark button, but briefly, you cannot read the same scrolls or scrolls with similar effects. If you try to read a scroll that doesn’t meet the requirements, nothing will happen because you will see a lock icon on the scroll.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/ff77860ec00f17fe9078ef0f63ad6e9e527c9110.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/3350dd75aad3588a56bf68c2d674e7b8fbaa144d.jpg
Additionally, we have weakened the damage scrolls against beasts (Scroll of the Hunter).


2. Traps on the roads no longer stop the Tradesman! Drive over traps and receive your damage for inattention completely free and quickly!

3. Mercenaries now gain experience at the end of battles. Each mercenary has their own bar with ten random attribute enhancements. Leveling up mercenaries will take some time, and it will be minimal if your mercenaries are already strong and fighting against strong enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/fb88c4cd2dea7cca018c8f24627ede6e6ca749eb.jpg
Talents can be replaced with other random ones by spending either Mercenary Upgrade Points or money. You can choose the currency with a special button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/a07284445fcb02c01a3c8c60b9295a19be702171.jpg
ATTENTION: This is one of those improvements that required us to modify saves and change data. Just for your information.

4. We added a potion called "Strength of Seven", which gives the Tradesman +10 to attack FOREVER once per game. There is no way to know the recipe for this potion in the game. It’s a secret potion; we just decided to let you know.

5. Quick Battle (wow, why is this fifth and not first?). We introduced a quick battle feature, somewhat like in Heroes of Might and Magic 3, but not quite. Quick Battle is designed for those who possess incredible strength and do not wish to waste time on weaklings. You receive NO rewards (zero rewards) for a quick battle but may lose goods in case of defeat. To access Quick Battle, you need to have fought and defeated all enemies at least once on a road.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/e59b9f773babcd6aca62ea2c518caf7671861257.jpg
This mechanic will save a lot of time on simple and medium roads even at the beginning of the game. The Tradesman and his squad will face eight random enemies generated under the same rules as on a regular road. Since NO enhancements (zero enhancements) work in Quick Battles, don’t expect to ever win a battle against eight bears, for example. You can find the formulas for calculating player and opponent strength in the Quick Battle menu under the question mark button.

6. New item: Note of Commendation, which grants 100 reputation in the location where the note is activated.

7. The Stray Cat that accompanies your cart can now attack.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/1e0c7e8abc462b24f38f62f6bf457922395778f8.gif

8. A new button has appeared on the road interface; hovering over it will allow you to read some information.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/aff26cd13aa5e46187c616d115baeb7ae43a6647.jpg

9. Road event: Hungry Cats. Feed the cats fish to receive a reward and help from the cats in battle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/23417b9a39cc3c4883e26693d1de73df44e5ec26.jpg

10. Road event: Postmen Lumpkin and Chumpkin. Help them with letters and receive a Note of Commendation as a reward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/41dc9b60ac63cf1e837face4cee7da2db221b4d2.jpg

11. Road events: Once again, Denny. For an entry fee, you can win something or get into trouble.

12. Road event: Honey Seller. Buy some honey from the honey seller! And bees, but sometimes. The event activates after completing a certain quest.

That's all for now.

Heyo! Small patch with some stuff.

There are limitations, but this will help reduce the number of battles by half at the beginning of the game, and it will also make it easier to complete certain quests.

notes.title: Patch 0.2024.11.08
notes.content:
Greetings! We have completed another patch, adding/fixing various things and a new location - Eaton. So, what’s in the patch?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/ffaef969f9027e53c121d46c57e86e0e2214f28d.jpg

1. Improved some interface elements (for convenience).
2. Now the characters you are transporting will indicate where they need to be taken when you are in the city (after a few seconds of being in the city).
3. Mercenaries in reserve can now also be swapped (special arrows have been added).
WARNING: Experience shows that any changes to the reserve code lead to some bugs. I hope this patch is different. But that’s just hope. If anything goes wrong, we will fix it.
4. Almost all items in the quest tab of the inventory will not increase road danger level. Not all, but almost all.
5. A reputation display button in cities (look for it on the map in the lower left corner, hotkey "5").
6. The settlement of Eaton, where actions will:
   6a. Allow gathering herbs on the roads - we have added six different herbs.
   6b. Allow brewing potions from herbs (currently, four potions are available, but you need to gain reputation to unlock all recipes). Your reputation in Eaton does not affect your ability to brew potions, so if you somehow learned a recipe, you can brew potions without reputation. One of the potions is inspired by a comment from a player that we saw somewhere.
   6c. Give access to a new legendary bandit - Gavroche.
7. At the moment, we are not updating the demo version, as its content is limited to already completed locations. The following localizations are fully present in the game: Russian, English, and Simplified Chinese. The current patch includes the Korean localization from the previous patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/b465486faf84f56f2622ed0430c090c32b2c7d8c.jpg

There is only one quest in the Eaton - to gather herbs for a witch Manita, so you can run around the locations again. But the quest is completely optional. Additionally, white wolf coats (aka pelts) are sold in Eaton.

We continue to work on the game; thank you for playing. The next content patch will likely be released in December, as we will have a break starting mid-month, also known as vacation. Our programmer (that is, me) will continue working on various small details and, of course, prepare for future content.
Currently, our plans include:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/44d3d70ac9a2dbc06759eae4d687ac5340bbb60a.jpg

1. A long (but not too long!) quest with mini-bosses and a new big boss in the Eastern Lands.
2. A location with hot springs and a legendary mercenary in the Snowy Lands.
3. Several mercenaries in already prepared locations.
4. Talking about the main story: two quests have been ready for a while now, but we are not yet ready to open up the continuation of the quest chain. I believe that the story part can still wait. Thanks to feedback, we have changed and added so much that we haven’t had time to focus on story quests. We still plan to connect locations in the Eastern Lands to create a closed trade loop. Eaton is the first step towards this.
Well then. I’m done!

notes.title: Patch 0.2024.10.08
notes.content:
1. Added Gristers - a new rare mercenary, and the third property of Flour product (must see!)
2. Due to a bug, ambushes did not appear in the game as they should. Now they do, and you will have to take them into account. Ambushes begin to appear at road danger level 5 and higher (and not as it was before, after many reworks, at road danger 15 and higher).
3. Enemies from an ambush will appear with a fully recharged attack.
4. The property of the Gray Wolf Skin product, which ensures an encounter with a full pack of wolves, is now generated as an additional combat encounter on the road, and not as a replacement for an existing one.
5. Thanks (huh?) to the changes above, the maximum number of mandatory combat encounters (excluding additional modifiers) is ALWAYS equal to two (just like ppl write in some reviews!).
6. Nerf: Now escaping from a road costs money (usually small, but money).
7. Buff: Now it is cheaper to negotiate with the enemy squad at later stages (amount is limited to 500, but you're unlikely to need that.)
8. Additional road from Fishpool to Fortsville (so as not to interrupt Dealer's bonus)
9. New location in the snowy region - Sheepington and a new epic mercenary - Defender Sheep. There are few quests in the location, since it requires other locations that are in development. Therefore, the secret of the settlement remains a secret for now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/e1767067429ad35b0360101f7a6983e09ae2f9b4.jpg
10. The ability "Order: Protect" has been significantly weakened, since it gives a 90% chance of intercepting a blow / Redirect, which is twice as much as any mercenary-defender. 40% from 60%, and 60% from 90% when improved. The healing effect from "Order: Protect" remained the same.
11. Additional mechanics for selling goods that are not needed by NPCs - Pitching. Now you can try to sell any goods (not scrolls, not food) to a merchant, get the full price for the goods, bonus reputation. But there is a risk that the merchant will stop trading with you until the next restock (the numbers are displayed in the interface).
12. Hidden from players modification: additional mercenary upgrade slots. Technically, mercenaries can have a scroll and food, so two slots. We added 8 more slots for mercenaries (your saves will be modified accordingly). This will allow us to add additional boosts of different types for mercenaries in the future. On the negative side, although we tested everything in the beta branch, this may break something in the game. I hope not.
13. Regarding localizations: All localizations, except Russian and English, are made by third parties (fan-made). Therefore, there are no guarantees that these localizations will always be and will be updated with each patch (of the current localizations, this applies to Turkish and Korean). The fact that the localizations are fan-made is indicated on the game page. This patch content only supports Russian, English, and Chinese (simplified) for now.

notes.title: Somefixes
AAAAA! Patch v.0.2024.09.13
notes.content:
Greetings! Here’s the new patch. Before describing the patch, I’d like to remind you that the game is in early access, and bugs, glitches, and so on are possible. Currently, bugs related to the game CODE are being fixed within a timeframe of 15 minutes to 12 hours.
By the way, if you're eager to report a bug or follow the development more closely, you can visit our Discord (the link can be found on the game page).
So, here’s the patch!

1. The properties of the "Silver ore" item have been weakened by half.
2. The chances of obtaining epic and legendary items from boxes have been slightly increased.
3. The reserve has been expanded by 5 additional slots, but read on!
4. All bears have had their attack speed increased; they are now slightly better as allies and a bit more dangerous as opponents.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/5df0ba0303c241df8d71dd7c60f5fe81994e0ed9.jpg
5. The scroll merchant in Normingham now sells twice as many level-up scrolls.
6. Skeleton necromancers now lose more health when resurrecting allies. They now lose MAXIMUM health instead of current health.
7. Two new quests have appeared in Boneton, one of which leads to the next point.
8. After completing the quest in Boneton, the Quality of Life Altar will become available with the following multi-level upgrades for gold:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/3e8895f7c731f0aed37e0c33e46f0668e271cc6c.jpg
Quality Strength - Extra damage distributed randomly between allied mercenaries at the start of a fight.
Quality Body - Extra health distributed randomly between allied mercenaries at the start of a fight.
Quality Respect - Gives a chance of finding a letter of commendation after defeating the last party of enemies.
Quality Hiring I - The minimum level of at least one mercenary is increased when hiring in settlements.
Quality Finds I - If legendary items, food, or scrolls are found in a box, there is a chance that the box will contain another legendary item, food, or scroll.
Quality Roads - At the beginning of a journey, there is a chance of traveling along a safe road without any incidents.
Quality Reserve - Reserve size is increased.
Quality Hiring II - When hiring a mercenary, there is a chance he will have been lectured by a random scroll.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/851e9ee46513599d3df1b1eeff082ffc536d0e04.jpg
That's all for now.

- There is now a separate inventory tab for quest items. Quest items can no longer be lost, their rarity has also been reduced, but now they MINIMALLY increase road danger level. Upon the first launch of the patched game, all quest items and books will be moved to the new inventory tab (hopefully without issues).
- The Northeast is now open. Completed locations in the Northeast: Gravesville, Rebelton, Prudeshire, Upper Squintytown. Partially completed locations: Piousville, Boneton. To finish these locations, we need to add a few more areas, but it’s time to release the patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/7d872e4cd5449f0b46c61642871cba04dfbc70bc.png

notes.title: Quick announcement
notes.content:
Greetings.
Some time has passed since the release of the game, and all this time we have been working on fixes, adding functionality based on player requests, reading cool comments and reviews, even adding support for two languages ​​thanks to the fans, which, of course, will now complicate the development of the game for us, since localisations need to be supported ːchkː

Why am I writing this news? The game is currently working quite stable, and we are getting to work on continuing the storyline, new quests and locations. Of course, working on this will take more time than it will take you to go through all this new content, but that is the essence of development ːdioː
What's in the plans:
1. Quests and opening locations in the northeast.
2. Continuation of the main story of the game after the quest with filling the table with food.
3. Gradual and partial merging of zones, so that the winter location and the northeastern location do not have only one entrance and exit. As a result, we will tie everything together from a certain point in the game, and it will be possible to Bargain in a big circle.
4. While developing the above, we will complete some current events and add new goods.

We read all the comments in the community and write down a lot of things in our wish book, but we do not take responsibility for answering to all comments. I tried, but some (NOT ALL) commentators turn out to be some kind of dissatisfied demons who want to change everything to suit their personal taste, and perceive my answers as the beginning of a discussion in which they need to convince the developer that he is wrong. That's not how it works.

Thank you for playing and writing your suggestions. This is helpful, really.

notes.title: Patch 0.2024.07.06 + 简体中文
notes.content:
1. Dealer's bonus is no longer reset when spending the night.
I would like to note that these are not bugs: Dealer's bonus is still reset when you exit the game or if you have not sold anything in a location, even if there is no merchant in the location. Why did you go there?

notes.title: Patch 0.2024.07.03
notes.content:
1. We added Gigachading (the development name for the mechanic), in other words, Dealer mechanic.
A small mechanic that allows you to earn more money and rewards you for consistent trading. Sell ​​the goods that the merchant in the location needs, get a bonus to the demand selling prices, and move to the next location.
You receive the Dealer's bonus for each location dealt, up to a maximum of +30% to the price of goods in demand. The bonus is lost if you visit a dealt location again or if you drive out onto the road without dealing with goods in the current location.
It's not that complicated! We just added this mechanic, so it may have problems.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/a12b2a2e7e3f8b73a5f8015dc2aab6f9b22d7f2a.jpg

2. Now, when you hover mouse cursor over a city on the map, you can see a small hint whether you have goods demanded by merchants in your inventory.
3. There are now bats in the caves. Yes, this is also important.
4. A couple of transportation quests are now displayed in the quest book.
5. Planks now give less health to enemies. A tier 1 product, of course, shouldn't be so tough. Even though they are planks, they are tough.
6. The barbarian Barbar's passive ability to devour food has been brought to an adequate level. 100% it was too much, that’s not how things are done.
7. Now, when a legendary mercenary is dismissed, his level will be saved. To buy it back, you will have to spend more money, of course.
8. If you are tracking a quest, for example, about bringing goods, you can now click on the quest text in the upper left corner to open the quest window, where that particular quest will be highlighted.
9. Language Localisation Rules.txt in game folder was updated. Now you can test dialog localisations.

notes.title: Patch 0.2024.07.01
notes.content:
0. All known and confirmed bugs are eliminated!
1. Mercenaries did not return money upon dismissal the reserve. Now they are returning the money.
2. In pop-up windows you can now change values ​​not only by scrolling the mouse (it was possible before too!), but also by using the A/D buttons and arrows, as well as entering the desired number.
3. Work with game files has been improved, and now there is much less chance of losing saves if the game is closed incorrectly. But there is still no guarantee that during a power surge nothing will happen to your saves. There are no such guarantees. There are no guarantees. Nope, can't give the guarantees.
4. When you hover mouse cursor over a mercenary on the road, you can see the numerical value of his health/maximum health.
5. The size of the game files has increased because we have added support for various languages ​​(Chinese, Thai, Korean).
>>>Support, not the localizations themselves!<<<
Also in the game folder there is a file "Language Localization Rules.txt" for those who want to translate the texts or want to help with this, as we were asked to do.
6. Through the efforts of Ali İbrahim Çırpan and İbrahim Büber, Turkish language localisation was added to the game. Please note that this is a fan translation.

Thank you for playing, we work for you. And for ourselves too, we like to make a game.

notes.title: Quick announcement
notes.content:
Greetings!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508196/e026519e9b5ae68830247a411c9df17783400d0f.png
We read all the reviews and read the posts in the community, and have already added some elements to the game, and are working on others. I would like to write here what we will do in the near future (and what we will not do). Please note that this is an Early Access game and you will only be able to get the full gaming experience in the full version, because if we add everything that is asked for to the game right now, the game will immediately release (haha, this is impossible because players do not take into account such a parameter as “time”, there are only two of us).
1. We will add level up scrolls in Normingham (the update has been postponed for now due to reasons beyond our control).
2. We are already working on a reserve for mercenaries, so that you can keep spare mercenaries separate from the squad. But I will say that it will not be possible to change mercenaries during the road, only in safe locations. Reserved mercenaries will keep their scrolls and level. This is how we see it.
3. Regarding reputation in locations - it is planned that half of the 10,000 reputation or a little more will be obtained for completing quests. It will not be possible to gain all the reputation in a location through quests.
3a. Regarding reputation rewards, I would like to remind that this is early access, and we do not have time to do everything at once and at the same time. Especially after receiving requests to add elements to the game that were not in the plans, but which turned out to be necessary.
4. For some reason, someone in the reviews decided that the game should have gamepad support. Nope.
5. Regarding translations of the game into other languages ​​- in Early Access this is a rather labor-intensive task that will delay all other updates. More languages - the more money we spend on translations - the longer they take - the later the updates.
6. Regarding the grind, we can’t please everyone.
7. Regarding various events on the roads - there will be more of them, but those that exist are still not completed. I'm talking about Den, Nurlan, even about the Caravan, these events are planned to be continued.

Thank you for your reviews and feedback, it seems to us that our Early Access is working as it should.
